question: As per the Census-2011, the population growth during the decade remained ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**17.64**__

• **17.64** is the population growth rate as per the Census-2011.
 
• The Census is conducted every ten years to collect data on various demographic parameters in India.
 
• The growth rate indicates the percentage increase in the population over the decade.
